## Overview

Defines 20-gene signatures for prostate tumour-cell lineage and plasticity states, including neuroendocrine (NEPC-like) and AR-negative/PSMA-negative double-negative-like (DNPC-like) states, and scores them in every PRINCE stratum. The signatures are derived **only** from the external PCCAT single-cell atlas, never from PRINCE data, so their association with response is not circular.

From advanced-disease (CRPC, mCRPC, NEPC) epithelial cells, a state's markers are the genes with the largest log2 fold change against all other epithelial states. They must be detected in at least 25% of the state's cells, have mean CPM10k ≥ 1 in the state and be higher than the out-group in at least 70% of donors carrying the state (donors with ≥ 10 cells). Signatures are made for each fine (ct.L3) state and for coarse lineages (NE, LPC, club, hillock, basal, luminal). The DNPC-like set contrasts non-NE epithelial cells with zero counts for *AR*, *FOLH1*, *CHGA*, *SYP*, *INSM1* and *ASCL1* against AR+ *FOLH1*+ luminal cells; the reverse contrast gives an AR+/PSMA+ luminal set.

In PRINCE, signatures are scored with singscore over the stratum's LOQ-detected genes at AOI level, and at patient-pseudobulk level by singscore and mean z-score (at least five detected genes). The number of each signature's genes above LOQ is recorded, so poorly measured signatures can be flagged downstream.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Supplementary Table 66 (S66_PCCAT_state_signatures), via `comp_29_supp_tables_v4`
- Scores used by the association, validation and critical-review analyses of the PCCAT tumour-state scores (`comp_33a`, `comp_33b`, `comp_33c`; Supplementary Tables 67–73)
- Methods: Atlas-derived tumour-state signatures
- Results: 'Re-evaluation of earlier neuroendocrine, purity and bone-niche findings' (lineage-state paragraph)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 33_pccat_states`.

**Inputs**

- `data/refs/pccat_subsample.qs`
- `data/phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs`
- `results/R1_loq/loq_gene_universes.qs`
- `results/C13_pseudobulk_LOQ/pseudobulk_strata.qs`
- `data/reference/msigdb_gene_sets.rds`

**Outputs**

**Depends on**: `comp_03a_build_refs`, `comp_00b_bone_cohort`, `comp_16_loq_filter`, `comp_13b_pseudobulk_loq`

## Analysis

### PCCAT tumour-state signatures
The header states the rule that signatures come only from the external atlas, and summarises the marker criteria and the scoring in PRINCE.

Load packages and check that at least 25 GB of RAM is free, because the atlas count matrix is large.

```{r comp-33-pccat-states-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE -- R11: PCCAT tumour-state signatures (NEPC-like and other lineage states) and scoring.
## Signatures are defined ONLY from the external PCCAT atlas (refs/pccat_subsample.qs), never from
## PRINCE data.
##  A. Tumour epithelial cells from advanced disease (CRPC, mCRPC, NEPC). For each ct.L3 state,
##     donor-level pseudobulk (CPM) per state; top-20 markers = genes with the largest
##     log2FC vs all other epithelial states, requiring detection in >= 25% of the state's cells,
##     mean CPM10k >= 1 in the state, and higher in >= 70% of donors with that state.
##     Coarse lineages pooled the same way: NE (all NE_*), LPC, Club, Hillock, Basal, Luminal.
##  B. Data-driven 'AR-low / PSMA-low, non-NE' (double-negative-like, DNPC-like) cells:
##     advanced-disease epithelial cells with AR = 0 and FOLH1 = 0 counts, no NE marker
##     (CHGA, SYP, INSM1, ASCL1 = 0), excluding ct.L2 NE; top-20 markers vs AR+ FOLH1+ luminal cells.
##  C. Scores in PRINCE: AOI level (singscore over LOQ-detected genes of the stratum) and patient
##     pseudobulk (singscore and mean z), all nine strata; plus FOLH1, AR (Hallmark) and
##     KLK3/AR panel for reference. Detection of signature genes above LOQ is reported.
## Outputs: results/R11_pccat_states/
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({ library(qs); library(Matrix); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(edgeR); library(singscore) })
setwd(PRINCE_DIR)
check_ram_or_stop(25)
out_dir <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R11_pccat_states"); dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

### A. State signatures from the atlas
Restrict the PCCAT subsample to epithelial cells (luminal, basal, club, hillock, LPC, NE) from CRPC, mCRPC and NEPC samples. `stats_for` normalises to counts per 10,000, takes the 200 candidates with the largest log2 fold change (pseudocount 0.1) among genes detected in ≥ 25% of in-state cells with mean ≥ 1, keeps those higher than the out-group mean in ≥ 70% of donors with ≥ 10 state cells, and returns the top 20. This is run for every fine state against all other epithelial states and for every coarse lineage.

```{r comp-33-pccat-states-02}
## ---- A + B. signatures from PCCAT ---------------------------------------------------------------
pc <- qs::qread("refs/pccat_subsample.qs", nthreads = 1); X <- pc$counts; m <- pc$meta
epi <- m$ct.L2 %in% c("Luminal", "Basal", "Club", "Hillock", "LPCs", "NE") & m$Group2 %in% c("CRPC", "mCRPC", "NEPC") & !is.na(m$ct.L3)
X <- X[, epi]; m <- m[epi, ]; lib <- pmax(Matrix::colSums(X), 1)
cat("advanced-disease epithelial cells:", ncol(X), "\n"); print(table(m$ct.L3, m$Group2))
m$coarse <- ifelse(m$ct.L2 == "NE", "NE_all", paste0(m$ct.L2, "_all"))
norm10k <- function(cols) X[, cols, drop = FALSE] %*% Diagonal(x = 1e4 / lib[cols])
stats_for <- function(in_cells, out_cells, label) {
  a <- norm10k(which(in_cells)); b <- norm10k(which(out_cells))
  mi <- Matrix::rowMeans(a); mo <- Matrix::rowMeans(b); det <- Matrix::rowMeans(a > 0)
  lfc <- log2(mi + 0.1) - log2(mo + 0.1)
  ## donor consistency: fraction of donors (with >= 10 cells in the state) where state mean > out mean
  dn <- table(m$Donor_ID[in_cells]); dn <- names(dn[dn >= 10])
  cand <- names(sort(lfc[det >= 0.25 & mi >= 1], decreasing = TRUE))[1:200]; cand <- cand[!is.na(cand)]
  cons <- if (length(dn) >= 2) sapply(cand, function(g) mean(sapply(dn, function(d) { cc <- which(in_cells & m$Donor_ID == d)
    mean(X[g, cc] * 1e4 / lib[cc]) > mo[g] }))) else setNames(rep(1, length(cand)), cand)
  keep <- cand[cons >= 0.7]
  data.frame(signature = label, gene = head(keep, 20), log2FC = lfc[head(keep, 20)], det = det[head(keep, 20)],
             mean_in = mi[head(keep, 20)], donor_consistency = cons[head(keep, 20)], n_cells = sum(in_cells), n_donors = length(dn))
}
sigs <- list()
for (st in sort(unique(m$ct.L3))) sigs[[st]] <- stats_for(m$ct.L3 == st, m$ct.L3 != st, st)
for (co in sort(unique(m$coarse))) sigs[[co]] <- stats_for(m$coarse == co, m$coarse != co, co)
```

### B. Double-negative-like cells
Non-NE epithelial cells with zero counts for *AR*, *FOLH1* and the NE markers *CHGA*, *SYP*, *INSM1* and *ASCL1* are contrasted with AR+ *FOLH1*+ luminal cells, and the reverse contrast is also run, using the same marker criteria. All signatures are written to the top-20 table, the atlas object is freed, and the leading genes of each signature are printed.

```{r comp-33-pccat-states-03}
## B. DNPC-like
g0 <- function(g) if (g %in% rownames(X)) X[g, ] == 0 else rep(TRUE, ncol(X))
dn_cells <- m$ct.L2 != "NE" & g0("AR") & g0("FOLH1") & g0("CHGA") & g0("SYP") & g0("INSM1") & g0("ASCL1")
arpos <- m$ct.L2 == "Luminal" & X["AR", ] > 0 & X["FOLH1", ] > 0
cat("DNPC-like cells:", sum(dn_cells), " AR+FOLH1+ luminal:", sum(arpos), "\n"); print(table(m$ct.L3[dn_cells]))
sigs[["DNPC_like"]] <- stats_for(dn_cells, arpos, "DNPC_like")
## also the reverse: AR+/PSMA+ luminal signature vs DNPC-like (should anti-correlate)
sigs[["ARpos_PSMApos_luminal"]] <- stats_for(arpos, dn_cells, "ARpos_PSMApos_luminal")
sig_tab <- bind_rows(sigs); rm(pc, X); invisible(gc())
write.csv(sig_tab, file.path(out_dir, "A_PCCAT_state_signatures_top20.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sig_list <- split(sig_tab$gene, sig_tab$signature)
cat("\nSignatures (top genes):\n"); for (s in names(sig_list)) cat(sprintf("%-24s %s\n", s, paste(head(sig_list[[s]], 10), collapse = ",")))

```

### C. Scoring PRINCE
For each of the nine strata (Control AOIs excluded), compute singscore for every PCCAT signature and the two AR reference sets (Hallmark androgen; *AR*, *KLK3*, *FOLH1*, *NKX3-1*, *HOXB13*), with *FOLH1* and *AR* log2 CPM alongside. This is done at AOI level on TMM log2 CPM over the stratum's LOQ universe, and at patient level on the pseudobulk, where a mean z-score version is added. Scores need at least five detected genes. The number of each signature's genes above LOQ is tabulated per stratum. Scores are saved as a list (signatures, AOI and patient tables) and as CSV files.

```{r comp-33-pccat-states-04}
## ---- C. score PRINCE -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
se <- qs::qread("phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs"); cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
uni <- qs::qread(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "loq_gene_universes.qs"))$universes
pbs <- qs::qread(out_path("C13_pseudobulk_LOQ", "pseudobulk_strata.qs"))
msig <- readRDS(file.path(PMCC_DIR, "msigdb_gene_sets.rds"))
ref_sets <- list(AR_Hallmark = msig$H$HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE, AR_panel5 = c("AR", "KLK3", "FOLH1", "NKX3-1", "HOXB13"))
all_sets <- c(sig_list, ref_sets)
artefact_re <- "^(USP17L|PRAMEF|NBPF|OR[0-9]+[A-Z]+[0-9]+)"
counts_all <- assay(se, "all_count"); counts_all <- counts_all[!grepl(artefact_re, rownames(counts_all)), ]
code <- c("CD45+" = "CD45", "PSMA+" = "PSMA", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCKPSMA"); tps <- c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")
keep_aoi <- cd$response_group_neat != "Control" & cd$timepoint %in% tps
aoi_scores <- list(); pt_scores <- list(); det_rows <- list()
for (sg in names(code)) for (tp in tps) {
  sid <- paste0(code[sg], "__", tp); g <- intersect(uni[[sid]]$g10, rownames(counts_all))
  idx <- which(keep_aoi & cd$segment_name == sg & cd$timepoint == tp)
  lc <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts_all[g, idx])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); rk <- rankGenes(lc); z <- t(scale(t(lc)))
  S <- sapply(all_sets, function(gs) { gg <- intersect(gs, rownames(lc)); if (length(gg) >= 5) simpleScore(rk, upSet = gg)$TotalScore else rep(NA, ncol(lc)) })
  aoi_scores[[sid]] <- data.frame(aoi = colnames(lc), stratum = sid, subject_id = cd$subject_id[idx], roi = cd$roi_name[idx], batch = cd$study_batch[idx],
                                  FOLH1 = lc["FOLH1", ], AR = if ("AR" %in% rownames(lc)) lc["AR", ] else NA, S, check.names = FALSE)
  p <- pbs[[sid]]; rkp <- rankGenes(p$lcpm); zp <- t(scale(t(p$lcpm)))
  Sp <- sapply(all_sets, function(gs) { gg <- intersect(gs, rownames(p$lcpm)); if (length(gg) >= 5) simpleScore(rkp, upSet = gg)$TotalScore else rep(NA, ncol(p$lcpm)) })
  Zp <- sapply(all_sets, function(gs) { gg <- intersect(gs, rownames(zp)); if (length(gg) >= 5) colMeans(zp[gg, , drop = FALSE]) else rep(NA, ncol(zp)) })
  colnames(Zp) <- paste0(colnames(Zp), "__z")
  pt_scores[[sid]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, subject_id = p$meta$subject_id, batch = p$meta$study_batch, FOLH1 = p$lcpm["FOLH1", ],
                                 AR = if ("AR" %in% rownames(p$lcpm)) p$lcpm["AR", ] else NA, Sp, Zp, check.names = FALSE)
  det_rows[[sid]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, signature = names(all_sets), n_genes = lengths(all_sets),
                                n_detected_LOQ = sapply(all_sets, function(gs) length(intersect(gs, g))))
}
qs::qsave(list(signatures = sig_list, aoi = bind_rows(aoi_scores), patient = bind_rows(pt_scores)), file.path(out_dir, "C_scores.qs"))
write.csv(bind_rows(aoi_scores), file.path(out_dir, "C_aoi_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(pt_scores), file.path(out_dir, "C_patient_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(det_rows), file.path(out_dir, "C_signature_detection.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nDetection of signature genes above LOQ (min across strata):\n")
print(as.data.frame(bind_rows(det_rows) %>% group_by(signature) %>% summarise(n_genes = first(n_genes), min_det = min(n_detected_LOQ), max_det = max(n_detected_LOQ))), row.names = FALSE)
cat("R11 complete.\n")
```
